import numpy as np
import os

# Load data
print("Loading data...")

test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_test_2.csv", encoding="utf-8")

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Create ID columns using same format as sample_submission
train_df["id"] = (
    train_df["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + train_df["token_id"].astype(str)
)
test_df["id"] = (
    test_df["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + test_df["token_id"].astype(str)
)

# Proper validation split - NEVER train on this data
split_idx = int(len(train_df) * 0.9)
val_df = train_df.iloc[:split_idx]
train_df_final = train_df.iloc[split_idx:]

print(f"Validation size: {len(val_df)}, Training size: {len(train_df_final)}")

# Build pattern mapping from training data only
pattern_map = {}
for _, row in train_df_final.iterrows():
    key = row["before"]
    val = row["after"]
    pattern_map[key] = val

print(f"Pattern map built with {len(pattern_map)} unique keys")


def normalize_text(before):
    """Return normalized text using pattern lookup or original text"""
    return pattern_map.get(before, before)


# Efficient prediction using list comprehension (avoids pandas overhead)
before_values = test_df["before"].tolist()
test_predictions = [normalize_text(before) for before in before_values]

# Sort by id to match expected output order
submission_data = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"], "after": test_predictions})
submission_data = submission_data.sort_values("id").reset_index(drop=True)

# Save submission file

print(f"Submission saved to {submission_file_path}")

val_true = val_df["after"].values

correct = sum(v == p for v, p in zip(val_true, val_pred))
accuracy = (correct / len(val_true)) * 100
